collected_dynamic_variables.pain_points: Missed calls; Juggling clients, showings, and paperwork causing calls to slip through
collected_dynamic_variables.pain_frame: "Juggling clients, showings, and paperwork — calls just slip through."

transcript:
User: Hey! So I'm Sofia — I run a real estate office here in Houston. Your ad was talking about missed calls? That's literally me.
Agent: Got it, Sofia — you saw our Facebook ad about “missed calls,” and that’s hitting home. What’s been happening lately that’s causing you to miss them?
User: Oh, it's chaos! Juggling clients, showings, and paperwork — calls just slip through. Tell me more about your service!
Agent: Yeah, that sounds like nonstop—makes sense calls slip through. We help you stop losing business from missed calls by answering, capturing the lead’s details, and getting them routed to you or booked for a showing when you’re tied up; roughly how many calls a week are hitting voicemail right now?
User: I don’t track that... maybe 25? Or 30? But hey, I'm super interested in your service!
Agent: Got it — 25–30 a week is a lot, especially in real estate where people just move on to the next agent. Mind if I do a super quick 30‑second calculation to show what that could be costing you?
User: Sure, go ahead! I mean, it's probably around 25 missed calls. I'm curious about the numbers.
Agent: Got it — let’s use 25 missed calls a week. Of those, what percentage do you think would actually turn into a booked showing or signed client if you answered—like 25%, 50%?
User: Oh, definitely at least 50%! Every missed call counts in real estate. When can we start?
Agent: Love the urgency—makes sense. What’s your average value per new client or deal from a call, roughly, in dollars?
User: Depends, but average deal is around $300,000. Calls are crucial! I need a solution ASAP.
Agent: Got it — and yeah, if you’re around 25 missed calls a week and even 50% would convert, that’s huge. Just to make the math accurate: when you say $300,000, is that the home price, or what you actually earn per closed deal (your commission)?
User: Oh, that's the home price. My commission's around 3%. So yes, it's a big deal!
Agent: Got it — so at ~$9,000 commission per deal, even a conservative estimate puts you around **$487,100/month** in missed revenue from those slipped calls. It’s a 20‑minute walkthrough—Jay will show you exactly how it works and what your numbers look like with it on; what’s better for you, later today or tomorrow?
User: Wait, tomorrow works! Actually, I’m free tomorrow. What time are you thinking?
Agent: Perfect—tomorrow works. Before I suggest times, what time zone are you in: Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific?
User: Oh, I'm in Mountain time—no wait, scratch that. Central! Yep, Central Time here in Houston.
Agent: Got it — Central Time. What’s your last name?
User: Sure, it's Sofia Martinez. So, about scheduling, can we confirm tomorrow? Just making sure we're on the same page.
Agent: Yep—same page: we can set something up for tomorrow, I just need a couple details to lock it in. What’s the name of your real estate office?
User: Oh right, it's Lone Star Realty Group. Let's make sure we confirm the time, okay?
Agent: Got it — Lone Star Realty Group. And is the number you’re calling from the best contact number to reach you for the SMS confirmation?
User: Yes, this number works. Can you send the confirmation for the slot tomorrow? I need to re-confirm.
Agent: Got it — I can use this number, but I still need the digits to make sure it’s correct. What’s the best 10‑digit number to text the confirmation to?
User: Sure! It's 713-555-7890. Please text the confirmation, and let’s double-check the time for tomorrow.
Agent: One moment while I check availability... I can get you in tomorrow as soon as **10:00 AM** or **10:45 AM** Central Time— which works?
User: Actually, let's do 10:45 AM Central Time. Can you confirm that for me? Just want to double-check.
Agent: Perfect, Sofia — you’re all set for tomorrow at 10:45 AM Central. You’ll receive an SMS text with the confirmation details so you can add it to your calendar in one click, or reschedule if you need to. Is there anything else I can help you with?
